news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 19%
news.body: After last week's 19% share price gain to ₹168, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 21.9x. Average trailing P/E is 16x in the Packaging industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 58% over the past year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.06 (vs ₹1.98 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.06 (down from ₹1.98 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.46b (up 7.6% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.29m (down 97% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.1% (down from 3.4% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: Subam Papers Limited announced that it has received INR 743.6752 million in funding from a group of investors
news.body: On February 4, 2026, Subam Papers Limited closed the transaction. The company issued 2,632,800 convertible warrants at an issue price of INR 38 for gross proceeds of INR 100,046,400 and 4,234,400 equity shares at an issue price of INR 643,628,800  for total aggregate gross proceeds of INR 743,675,200. The transaction included participation from Thirupathi Balakumar for 1,316,000 warrants, BMM Paper Board Private Limited for 987,200 warrants, Alagarsamy Sudha for 329,600 warrants, Invicta Continuum Fund I for 4,99,200 shares, Invicta Finserv Private Limited for 2,99,200 shares, MD Pai Partners LLP for 2,04,000 shares, Invicta Capserv Private Limited for 49,600 shares, Avvanti Advisors Private Limited  for 32,800 shares, Jinraj Enterprises LLP  for 19,200 shares and includes other investors.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.8x net interest cover). news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 2.9x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.9x net interest cover). Minor Risk Market cap is less than US$100m (₹4.48b market cap, or US$50.6m).
